item.text: {"verdicts":[{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0024-E001","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0024-E002","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0024-E003","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0024-E004","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0024-E005","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"In the 27 December 2023 election-manifesto speech, Hasina presented comparative 2006-to-2023 figures and claimed higher growth, income, budget size, exports, remittances, investment, and revenue.","notes":["The excerpt presents these figures in Hasina’s speech but does not explicitly characterize them as government-reported comparisons."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0024-E006","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0024-E007","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0024-E008","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0024-E009","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"UNFPA describes Bangladesh work with partners on disaster preparedness, assistance to Rohingya refugees and host communities, reproductive health care, gender inclusiveness and human rights, and reducing sexual and gender-based violence; the excerpt labels the listed results as achieved in 2024.","notes":["The excerpt does not support attributing the listed activities to Bangladesh’s 2023 program activities or stating that government spending shares varied by activity."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0024-E010","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0024-E011","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]}]}
